conversation.content: need help with re_arrange function - how should we approach rearranging an array in alternating pos and neg items? Any tips on the best algo to use?

def re_arrange(arr, n):
    pos = [x for x in arr if x >= 0]
    neg = [x for x in arr if x < 0]
    result = []
    i = 0
    j = 0
    while i < len(pos) and j < len(neg):
        result.append(neg[j])
        result.append(pos[i])
        i += 1
        j += 1
    while i < len(pos):
        result.append(pos[i])
        i += 1
    while j < len(neg):
        result.append(neg[j])
        j += 1
    return result
